title: Helping Grandma in the Garden
description: Three short recordings about helping Grandma: jobs in the garden, a phone message and a chat at home.
instructions: Read the questions for each part first. Then press Play and listen. Choose the best answer (A, B or C) for each question.

parts.title: Part 1 · Grandma and Tom
parts.intro: You will hear Tom talking to his grandma.

script.speaker: Grandma
script.text: Thank you for coming, Tom. I need help in the garden today.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: Of course, Grandma. What shall I do first?

script.speaker: Grandma
script.text: Please water the flowers. The red roses are very dry.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: OK. Shall I pick the apples too?

script.speaker: Grandma
script.text: Not yet. They're not ready. But you can pick the strawberries.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: Yummy! Can I eat one?

script.speaker: Grandma
script.text: Only one! They're for a cake.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: I'll fill the watering can at the tap now, and then I'll start with the roses.

script.speaker: Grandma
script.text: Thank you, dear. You're a very kind boy, and I love having you here.

parts.title: Part 2 · A message
parts.intro: You will hear Grandma leaving a message for Tom's mum.

script.speaker: Grandma
script.text: Hello, Anna, it's Mum. Tom was a great helper today. He watered the flowers, and he cut the grass with my little machine.

script.speaker: Grandma
script.text: After lunch, he planted some sunflower seeds near the fence. They'll be very tall by the summer.

script.speaker: Grandma
script.text: He also found a frog under a big stone! He put it by the pond.

script.speaker: Grandma
script.text: Please tell him I made chocolate cookies for him. I'll bring them on Sunday.

script.speaker: Grandma
script.text: Call me tonight if you have time. I want to hear about his new school. Bye for now, dear.

parts.title: Part 3 · At home
parts.intro: You will hear Tom talking to his mum, Anna, at home.

script.speaker: Anna
script.text: Did you have fun at Grandma's?

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: Yes! I was very tired, but it was great. My arms hurt.

script.speaker: Anna
script.text: What was the best thing?

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: The frog! But the worst thing was the big spider in the shed. I screamed!

script.speaker: Anna
script.text: Ha ha. Was Grandma happy?

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: Very. She said I'm her best helper. Next Saturday, I'm going to help her paint the fence.

script.speaker: Anna
script.text: What colour?

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: White, like the house.

script.speaker: Anna
script.text: That sounds like a lovely plan. I'll bring you some tea on Saturday morning.
